entities.summary: Takoubakoye Aminata Boureima (b. 1979-09-23, Niamey) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Niamey and Niger. Known in the fields of niger, merchants & economists, africa.
